pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo attano bhaṇḍakaṃ apassantiyo caṇḍakāliṃ bhikkhuniṃ etadavocuṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:1.5: ahameva nūna corī ahameva nūnālajjinī yā ayyā attano bhaṇḍakaṃ apassantiyo tā maṃ evamāhaṃsu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:1.7: sacāhayye tumhākaṃ bhaṇḍakaṃ gaṇhāmi assamaṇī homi brahmacariyā cavāmi nirayaṃ upapajjāmi
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:1.8: yā pana maṃ abhūtena evamāha sāpi assamaṇī hotu brahmacariyā cavatu nirayaṃ upapajjatūti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:1.9: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:1.10: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā caṇḍakālī attānaṃpi paraṃpi nirayenapi brahmacariyenapi abhisapissatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:1.11: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave caṇḍakālī bhikkhunī attānaṃpi paraṃpi nirayenapi brahmacariyenapi abhisapatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:1.14: hi nāma bhikkhave caṇḍakālī bhikkhunī attānaṃpi paraṃpi nirayenapi brahmacariyenapi abhisapissati
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:1.16: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:1.17.1: yā pana bhikkhunī attānaṃ vā paraṃ vā nirayena vā brahmacariyena vā abhisapeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:2.1.9: nirayena vā brahmacariyena vā abhisapati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:2.2.1: upasampannāya upasampannasaññā nirayena vā brahmacariyena vā abhisapati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:2.2.2: upasampannāya vematikā nirayena vā brahmacariyena vā abhisapati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:2.2.3: upasampannāya anupasampannasaññā nirayena vā brahmacariyena vā abhisapati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:2.2.4: tiracchānayoniyā vā pittivisayena vā manussadobhaggena vā abhisapati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
